Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - October 28, 2026) -
Ximen Mining Corp
(FSE: 1XM)

(the "Company" or "Ximen") provides an update on site readiness at the Kenville Gold Mine near Nelson, British Columbia, as the Company targets commencement of portal-face work in early November 2026.
Arrival of Mag for storage of explosives on site — Kenville Mine Project
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
Site Infrastructure and Equipment

Site buildings and supporting infrastructure are in place at Kenville, including office and change facilities, shop capacity, and related surface works. Power is connected to site. Primary mining and surface equipment for the planned start of portal-face work is on site, with critical spare parts held for key items. Certain backup equipment and support items remain off-site and are available to be mobilized as needed.
Survey and Portal Preparations
The survey plan for facing of the new portal has been completed. The Company is preparing to square the portal face and advance portal and decline work under its existing Mines Act authorization.
Loader with new tires, all tuned up and working on site — Kenville Mine Project
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
Crew
A startup crew has been assembled for the planned portal-face work, including:
Class 1 - urban and close proximity blaster for surface blasting / portal square up
Class 2 - underground blaster for all underground development
An experienced miner on site; and
A level 3 first aid certified person who will also take the role of occupational health and safety manager.
Additional crew members are planned to join as underground development advances, subject to operating needs.
On site 60-foot Kitchen Facility fully set up — Kenville Mine Project
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:
Timing

The Company is now targeting the start of portal work in early November 2026. This updates the original target date of the end of October 2026, disclosed in the Company's news releases of September 15 and September 18, 2026. The change reflects final site preparation and the need to complete remaining permit preconditions, including explosives Storage and Use authorization, before collaring the portal. Portal construction will commence once all safety protocols for explosives and overall site safety are established. The explosive magazines are on site, and we expect to have all requirements in place within the next two weeks to start portal construction and then the decline.
Financing

An update on financing is expected shortly. As previously disclosed on September 18, 2026, the Company has been in discussions regarding non-dilutive / development funding alternatives. Discussions are continuing and no definitive agreement has been entered into. There can be no assurance that any financing will be completed, within any particular timeframe, or on terms acceptable to the Company. Further details will be announced if and when definitive arrangements are entered into.

Readers are cautioned that historical records referred to in this News Release have been examined but not verified by a Qualified Person. Further work is required to verify that historical records referred to in this News Release are accurate.

About Ximen Mining Corp
To view an enhanced version of this graphic, please visit:

Ximen Mining Corp. acquired the Kenville Gold mine near Nelson British Columbia including all surface and underground property and mineral rights, buildings and equipment. The company also owns 100% interest in three of its precious metal projects located in southern BC., including two Gold projects, The Amelia Gold Mine and The Brett Epithermal Gold Project. Ximen also owns the Treasure Mountain Silver Project adjacent to the past producing Huldra Silver Mine. Currently, the Treasure Mountain Silver Project is under an option agreement. The option partner is making annual staged cash and stocks payments as well as funding the development of the project.

Ximen is a publicly listed company trading on the TSX Venture Exchange under the symbol XIM, in the USA under the symbol XXMMF, and in Frankfurt, Munich, and Berlin Stock Exchanges in Germany under the symbol 1XM and WKN with the number as A3E2DA.
